panel.title: ECAP Assistant
panel.subtitle: Ask about documents, tasks, attendance, leave

thread.welcomeTitle: Hi! How can I help you?
thread.welcomeDescription: I answer from internal documents and your own data, only within what you are allowed to see. I only read; I never change any data.

suggestions.tasks: Which of my tasks are not finished yet?
suggestions.leave: How many leave days do I have left this year?
suggestions.documents: What is the maximum overtime per month?
suggestions.forgotCheckIn: What should I do if I forget to check in?

thread.placeholder: Type a question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
thread.disclaimer: The AI assistant can make mistakes — double-check important information.

can.documents: Looking up rules, procedures and guides in documents you can view (PDF, Word, text)
can.work: Listing your unfinished tasks and the progress of projects you are in
can.leave: Telling you how many leave days you have left
can.attendance: Telling you whether you have checked in/out today

cannot.otherModules: Customers, warehouse, analytics figures, attendance on previous days
cannot.actions: Creating, editing, approving or deleting - I will show you how to do it in the app
cannot.fileTypes: Content of Excel, PowerPoint and image files

scope.tip: Tip: mention the document, project or time period for a more precise answer. Questions per day are limited; your usage appears at the bottom after each question.

history.confirmDeleteDescription: All questions and answers in this conversation will be permanently deleted.
